entities.summary: The Polish Centre of Mediterranean Archaeology University of Warsaw operates as an independent research institute of the University of Warsaw under the present name since 1990. It is dedicated to organizing, implementing and coordinating archaeological research, both excavations and study projects, as well as conservation, reconstruction and restoration projects, in northeastern Africa, the Near East and Cyprus. Projects include sites covering a broad chronological spectrum from the dawn of civilization through all the historic periods of the ancient Mediterranean civilizations to Late Antiquity and early Islam.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The Polish Centre of Mediterranean Archaeology has contributed significantly to our understanding of ancient civilizations in northeastern Africa and the Near East through its excavations and study projects. Its work has shed light on the cultural exchange and historical periods of these regions.
